annotations.title: Where to live in a Portuguese city, area by area

description: Where to live in a Portuguese city or region, area by area. The verdict of a flatin.pt guide for each area — live (good to live), depends (depends on you) or avoid (we advise against) — with the reason as written on the site, who it suits (families, no car, retirees, remote work, tight budget, nightlife) and the sources of its numbers. Also noise in plain words (festivals, bars, aircraft under approach paths) and safety as dated, sourced police operations — the local reputation of a place, never a claim about the people who live there. Call without `city` to list the cities that have a guide. Returns the guide's link: show it to the user.

city.description: City or region with a guide, in any site language (Porto, Lisbon, Lisboa, Greater Porto, Algarve, Coimbra) or a municipality inside a guide (Gaia, Cascais, Faro). Omit to list the guides

include.description: Parts of the guide to return. Default: areas, noise, safety

language.description: Language of the site content in the answer (verdicts, definitions, labels) and of the page links: pt, en, ru, ua (or uk), de, fr, nl. Field names and the summary stay English. Default: en

profile.description: Keep the areas that suit this profile; areas we advise against are always kept

verdict.description: Keep only areas with this verdict: live (good to live), depends (depends on you), avoid (we advise against)
